description: This file defines a PHP class 'Sass' within the Opencart admin controller namespace. The class contains a method to generate a CSS file from a SASS source file, primarily for admin interface styling.

classes.name: Sass
classes.description: A controller class responsible for generating CSS files from SASS source files within the admin panel of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that checks for the presence of the SASS file, compiles it into CSS, and saves the output, returning success or error messages.
